title: Email sign-in: missing, old and rejected codes
summary: Recover from wrong or expired email codes, use the newest message, and switch methods when email cannot be delivered.

steps.say: After your password, choose Email me a code. A sent message appears with the masked address and the code lifetime.
onScreen: We sent a six-digit code to l***@merit.example. It expires in 5 minutes.

steps.say: Email can take a minute or two. Check junk or spam, and check the masked address. Never send a verification code to support.
onScreen: You can ask for a new code in 29 seconds.

steps.say: If you mistype a code, MERIT explains the error and shows how many attempts remain. Read the message before trying again.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from the email (hidden)
onScreen: Some fields need attention · That code did not match. You can try 4 more times before you need a new code.

steps.say: An expired code cannot sign you in. Choose Send a new code after the resend countdown; repeated clicks will not speed up delivery.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from the email (hidden)

steps.say: Wait until Send a new code is available, then ask for another message. Use only the code from the newest email.
Requesting another code replaces the previous one. This example requests a newer message after the next countdown.
An older email no longer works after a newer code is sent. Use the newest message even if the older email arrives later.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from the email (hidden)
onScreen: Some fields need attention · That code was replaced by a newer one. Enter the code from the newest email, or send a new code.

steps.say: Too many wrong entries can also close a code. Instead of continuing to guess, get a new code or use your authenticator.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from the email (hidden)

steps.say: Use your authenticator app instead returns to the other verification method. Enter its current code to finish signing in.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: If MERIT cannot send the email, it shows a delivery error and support reference. Keep that reference when contacting support, rather than any code.
onScreen: We couldn't send your verification code. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact support. · Support reference: EM-JLTM8C79

steps.say: Choose Try sending again after a delivery failure. If email remains unavailable, use your authenticator or an unused recovery code.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from the email (hidden)

steps.say: An agency can withdraw email-code access. In that case, the email option disappears; your authenticator remains the way to sign in.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
onScreen: Enter your verification code · Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · Six-digit code from your authenticator app * · Or enter one of your ten-character recovery codes. · Verify and sign in · Can't access your authenticator? · Sign in as a different user
